mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workshop_apple_original(original_id,identity_hash) VALUES(#{id},#{identity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE identity_hash=COALESCE(identity_hash,VALUES(identity_hash))
mapper.select: SELECT original_id,identity_hash,order_reference,revoked,revoked_at FROM workshop_apple_original WHERE original_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workshop_apple_original SET order_reference=#{order} WHERE original_id=#{id} AND order_reference IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workshop_apple_original(original_id,revoked,revoked_at) VALUES(#{id},1,#{date}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE revoked=1,revoked_at=IF(revoked_at IS NULL,#{date},LEAST(revoked_at,#{date}))
mapper.update: UPDATE workshop_apple_original SET revoked=1, revoked_at=IF(revoked_at IS NULL,#{date},LEAST(revoked_at,#{date})) WHERE original_id=#{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workshop_apple_transaction(transaction_id,original_id,fact_hash) VALUES(#{id},#{original},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE transaction_id=transaction_id
mapper.select: SELECT transaction_id,original_id,fact_hash FROM workshop_apple_transaction WHERE transaction_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workshop_apple_notification(notification_uuid,payload_hash,signed_payload,state) VALUES(#{uuid},#{hash},#{payload},'PENDING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE notification_uuid=notification_uuid
mapper.select: SELECT notification_uuid,payload_hash,signed_payload,state FROM workshop_apple_notification WHERE notification_uuid=#{uuid} FOR UPDATE
